definitions.explanation: A suffix indicating the person in charge of or leading an organization, department, or group.

examples.japanese: {部長|ぶちょう}に{昇進|しょうしん}した。
examples.english: I was promoted to department head.

examples.japanese: {校長|こうちょう}{先生|せんせい}からお{話|はなし}があります。
examples.english: The principal has something to say.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}は{今|いま}{会議中|かいぎちゅう}です。
examples.english: The company president is in a meeting now.

notes:
〜{長|ちょう} is a productive suffix indicating a leader or head of an organization.

COMMON TITLES WITH 〜{長|ちょう}:

COMPANY:
- {社長|しゃちょう} - company president
- {部長|ぶちょう} - department head
- {課長|かちょう} - section chief
- {係長|かかりちょう} - supervisor

GOVERNMENT:
- {市長|しちょう} - mayor
- {県知事|けんちじ} - governor (uses {知事|ちじ})
- {長官|ちょうかん} - director-general

EDUCATION:
- {校長|こうちょう} - school principal
- {学長|がくちょう} - university president
- {学部長|がくぶちょう} - dean

OTHER:
- {会長|かいちょう} - chairman
- {委員長|いいんちょう} - committee chair
- {駅長|えきちょう} - station master
- {店長|てんちょう} - store manager
- {機長|きちょう} - captain (aircraft)

NOTE:
The 〜{長|ちょう} title is often used alone when addressing someone: {部長|ぶちょう}、これをお{願|ねが}いします。
